content: Might I suggest renaming this file? It's literally just named after the name of the author of the linked reference.

I think this is really a file about extending field extensions. In fact FieldTheory.Extension already exists, was written 4 years earlier, and contains similar results based on the same note by Isaacs.

We could simply merge the two files, since they're not long. Alternatively, we could rename to FieldTheory.Minpoly.Extension.
